scoring_justification: All headline quantities (T_KT, T_l, alpha) are recomputed from the agent's raw CSV artifacts; agent-reported values are only consistency-checked.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold KT temperatures (x=0.4, 0.9), Ising transition temperature and exponent (x=0.9)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.2 and text: T_KT=1.254(5) at x=0.4, 1.379(5) at x=0.9; T_l=0.36(2) at x=0.9; alpha approx 0.02
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported values; no synthetic data.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are direct paper-reported results; the checker recomputes from raw data and compares to these published numbers.

outputs.description: Crossing temperatures of the helicity modulus with the critical line, for every (x, L) combination. The checker recomputes T_KT by fitting a polynomial in L^{-1} and extrapolating to L=infty.
Agent-extrapolated KT transition temperatures. The checker compares these against its own recomputed T_KT from the raw crossings for consistency.
Specific heat as a function of temperature for L=36 at x=0.9. The checker locates the peak and performs a scaling analysis to obtain T_l and alpha.
Agent-extracted Ising transition temperature and critical exponent. The checker compares these against its own recomputed values from the specific heat data for consistency.

output_contract.notes: The Monte Carlo simulation is a required process step that must be executed by the agent; no precomputed simulation averages are provided. All scored outputs derive from the agent's own simulation data.

steps.description: Recompute T_KT by fitting a quadratic polynomial of T_cross vs 1/L for each x and extrapolating to 1/L=0; compare to paper gold.
Check that agent-reported KT temperatures match values recomputed from helicity_crossings.csv within 0.02.
Locate peak temperature and perform log-log scaling fit to extract exponent alpha; compare to paper gold.
Check that agent-reported T_l and alpha match values recomputed from specific_heat_L36_x0.9.csv within tolerances.
